tomato.context: Robot is at a stem. Tomato alpha has not been detected.
tomato.options:
A) detect
B) pick alpha
C) discard alpha
tomato.explanation: Ripeness is unobserved. Detect before choosing a ripeness-dependent action.

tomato.context: Robot is at the stem and alpha is detected ripe. The gripper is empty.
tomato.options:
A) pick alpha
B) discard alpha
C) navigate to dock_station
tomato.explanation: Pick the observed ripe tomato before transporting it. Ripeness alone does not establish freshness.

tomato.context: Robot holds alpha at dock_station. Freshness has not been scanned.
tomato.options:
A) scan alpha
B) place alpha
C) discard alpha
tomato.explanation: Scan to establish freshness before deciding placement or discard.

tomato.context: Robot holds alpha. Scan reports rotten.
tomato.options:
A) place alpha
B) discard alpha
C) pick alpha
tomato.explanation: The observation supports discard; placing rotten produce violates the task.

wastesorting.context: Item alpha is visible but its category is unknown. Gripper is empty.
wastesorting.options:
A) detect
B) pick alpha
C) place alpha in paper bin
wastesorting.explanation: Observe the category before making a category-specific sorting decision. Do not infer it from the item name.

wastesorting.context: Robot holds alpha. Detection reports paper.
wastesorting.options:
A) place alpha in paper bin
B) place alpha in plastic bin
C) detect
wastesorting.explanation: The observed category supports the paper bin.

wastesorting.context: Alpha blocks beta. Alpha is detected plastic; beta is occluded. Gripper is empty.
wastesorting.options:
A) pick alpha
B) pick beta
C) place beta in paper bin
wastesorting.explanation: Remove the observed blocking item before handling the hidden one. The hidden item category is unknown.

wastesorting.context: Robot holds alpha. Observations do not determine whether alpha is paper or plastic.
wastesorting.options:
A) place alpha in paper bin
B) place alpha in plastic bin
C) an option not listed here
wastesorting.explanation: Neither category-specific placement is justified. Clarification or further observation is needed.
